signals.title: Holders ~33% underwater — and still not selling
signals.detail: MVRV 0.67: price is 33% below the crowd's avg on-chain cost basis ($0.535). Yet 62% of supply is in the longest-held tier — the float isn't moving. MVRV has slipped 0.71→0.67 over ~30d.
signals.framing: Maximum financial pain, minimal capitulation — conviction being tested and, so far, holding.
signals.note: Describe the divergence, NOT a bottom call. "Not selling", not "buy".

signals.title: -84% below its all-time high
signals.detail: Deepest drawdown on record was -92%; it has made new highs after every prior one so far.
signals.framing: Deep drawdowns are the toll — it's paid them before (no recovery promise).
signals.note: It's deep and unrecovered NOW; don't imply it always recovers.

signals.title: Diamond tier grew 2.4pp in ~30d → 86.9% of supply
signals.detail: Supply in the longest-held tier rose 84.5%→86.9% over ~30 days — a cohort maturing into diamond.
signals.framing: Float tightening as coins age into the strongest-held tier.
signals.note: HELD, not BOUGHT — diamond grows by aging; frame it as maturing/held.
